exposure: In-class nutrition education with in-class feeding content
In-class nutrition education with online feeding content
outcome: Parents' understanding of new food acceptance
cohort: Parents of 2- to 8-year-old children enrolled in the EFNEP (Expanded Food and Nutrition Education Program) in low-resourced communities in Colorado and Washington.
finding: The program positively influenced parents' feeding knowledge, practices, and styles, with both online and in-class delivery methods being equally effective in promoting healthy feeding behaviors.
